$comment: Canonical parameters for the ground vehicle model files. Source column: project = read from the Java model/geometry sources; reference = measured from docs/plan/ground-units-reference-images.md R1; assumption = chosen for the export and flagged as inferred.

units.export_unit: 1 model unit; block and metre columns are derived
units.metre_conversion: 1 block = 1 m (assumption for the metric column only)
units.axes: Y up, nose along -Z, +X is the vehicle's right (same as the Java renderer)

missile_tubes.evidence: R3 shows a quad launcher box; tube count inferred

known_deviation.tank_vs_real_m1: The export envelope is 8.50 m nose-to-muzzle and 4.13 m wide; a real M1A5 is about 9.8 m gun-forward and 3.66 m wide. The model is the game envelope, not a dimensioned replica.
known_deviation.reference_ratio: R1 body length:height = 1202:555 = 2.17:1; the game hull is 100:50 = 2.00:1, a 7.7% deviation (see docs/plan/ground-units-model-log.md).
